front.title: OASNT-CAID: Canonical Action Identifier Derivation and the Named-Human Binding

abstract.t: This document profiles OASNT tokens for consumption by executor-side processing models. It fixes one normative derivation of a Canonical Action Identifier (CAID) from the OASNT action digest, so that every executor checks the same derivation rather than each integration defining its own, and it specifies the semantics of the token's named-human binding, including a subject-to-enrollment check whose absence this profile makes a refusal.
